question: What is required to be done in all ritual works, O goddess of the kula?
premises: The instruction applies to all works.
Something called Vishvamitra is prescribed as to be done.
The instruction is addressed to the kula goddess.
inference: In all works, the Vishvamitra is to be employed or made.
uncertainties: The precise referent of viśvāmitraṃ in this ritual context is unclear.
plain_english: O goddess of the kula, in all works the Vishvamitra should be used.
